_readme: Rulings that are no longer current but are kept for reference. Key = ruling id (from its link, #/ruling/<id>). asOf: the document version from which it no longer applies (shown as 'No longer current as of …'). reason (optional): one short sentence. replacedBy (optional): id of the ruling that replaces it. stagingTest: true shows the entry ONLY on staging.xwingarchives.com — use it for trying things out; never on a real deprecation.
